svg.title: koda: one edit turn
svg.desc: Timeline of one edit turn. The router classifies the request, an optional planner writes a checklist, and the coder calls tools in a loop while koda records every run in a tool log. koda hashes the workspace when the coder starts and again before verification. The tool log and the snapshot diff form the evidence. If no tool ran and nothing changed, the turn fails without an LLM call; otherwise one verifier call judges the evidence, treating the coder's answer as a claim. A failure is retried once with the verifier feedback.
svg.text: The verifier judges what koda recorded (a hash-snapshot diff and the real tool log), not what the model says it did.

svg.text: sha256 per file; new untracked files count too
t0 kept on retry: the diff is cumulative
Verifier prompt: “runs not in this list did
not happen.” Test output quoted in the answer
counts only with a matching tool run.
If the coder answers without calling a single
tool, it is re-run once: actually run it, do not
Still failing: koda run exits 1. Chat and TUI
keep the answer but tag it as unverified, so
later turns do not treat it as fact.
